summary: Tested new Symptom-to-Care Matching (triage) feature end-to-end. Backend /api/triage validates min-length (422) and returns Gurmukhi response with empty matches for Punjabi dentist query. Frontend: tab switch, panel visibility, disabled button, ENT Hindi routine flow with directory match and hospital detail expansion, emergency redirect for chest pain, clarifying question for vague input, example chip auto-submit, and mobile 390px viewport with no horizontal overflow all pass. Regression on home + lookup unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: triage.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing returns 503; acceptable but consider startup validation.
SymptomTriage.jsx handles Enter key to submit (shift+Enter for newline) - good UX.
triage.js posts sessionId from sessionStorage - persists across triage calls within tab, good.
_filter_matches strictly whitelists doctors from HOSPITAL_DATA which correctly prevents LLM hallucination - well designed.
seed_data_creation: None; used static hospital directory + inline small hospital array for backend Punjabi test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend triage endpoint at POST /api/triage requires User-Agent header when hitting via preview URL (Cloudflare 1010). LLM latency 10-30s so use 90s timeouts. All frontend testids listed in review request are present and working.
